landing.sourceStep1Text: Every primary source, PDF or Excel, is kept in the Fiscal.ge archive together with a link to the original.
landing.sourceStep2Text: Official line items are grouped into clear areas by documented rules.
landing.sourceStep3Text: Totals and series are checked against official reports before they are published.
landing.sourceStep4Text: CSV and JSON files and the MCP server, under the CC BY 4.0 licence.
